comments.author: fritzo
comments.body: Thanks for the detailed report @saitcakmak.  What do you think should be ideal behavior here?  Hanging is certainly bad, but stepsize=1e-100 seems bad also.  Maybe we should raise a `ValueError` to surface problem early?

comments.author: fritzo
comments.body:
I'm trying to push another release out today or tomorrow, so I'll just add lower and upper bounds say 1e-10 < step_size < 1e10.  Please LMK if you want different thresholds in the release.

https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/3157

comments.author: saitcakmak
comments.body: Thanks for the quick patch @fritzo! I am not sure what an ideal solution here would look like. Raising an error is also a good option. I don't have a preference either way, as long as it doesn't hang :) I ran our (BoTorch) unit tests as a quick check and the step size doesn't seem to get below 1e-10. In one other instance, I've seen the step size starting from 4.5e-16 and increasing a bit from there. This is from the same setup that produced the hanging behavior reported above. FWIW, the covariance matrix here is almost singular (half of the time, it would just raise a LinAlgError in Cholesky). So, that could possibly explain the small step size, but I am just speculating here.
